correctness.rationale: The forbidden five-word set follows by exhaustive two-symbol logic. A 16-state sliding-window graph is bijective with all admissible bi-infinite words; closed walks count periodic points. Exact integer Newton-identity computation confirms the characteristic polynomial and the zeta denominator. SCCs and core eighth-power positivity are independently recomputed by the embedded verifier, establishing Perron root phi and unique measure of maximum entropy. Finite brute force crosschecks cyclic words n<=12 and all words n<=14.

value.rationale: The triple is a natural distinguished pseudoperiod shared by all paperfolding sequences. The complete four-component phase portrait, a single maximal-entropy component, golden-ratio entropy, unique maximal measure and rational exact periodic zeta give a structurally motivated classification of all binary sequences with that triple, with consequences for every periodic orbit count. This is substantially more informative than testing an isolated pseudoperiod or enumerating a small finite set.
